note: Evidence type is separate from outcome status, test depth and scope. Categories do not automatically imply physical validity or priority.

types.label: Conceptual consistency
types.meaning: Coherence of definitions and concepts; does not show a real-world effect.

types.label: Mathematical result
types.meaning: A formally specified identity or theorem under declared assumptions. Distinguish proved results, proof sketches and checked examples.

types.label: Conditional model
types.meaning: A relationship following from a specified set of modelling assumptions; assumptions may not be physically selected.

types.label: Simulation
types.meaning: A computed result for recorded inputs, software, model and controls; not a physical measurement.

types.label: Observational analysis
types.meaning: A result derived from observations or existing data, with source, selection, uncertainty and comparator limits.

types.label: Controlled experiment
types.meaning: A measured intervention or prospective comparison under recorded controls and rejection criteria.

types.label: Independent replication
types.meaning: A new appropriately independent verification of a specific reported result, with its scope and method disclosed.

assessment_rule: Use reasons in words by default. Optional numbers require a named quantity, rubric, assessor and calibration status; uncalibrated scores must not be described as calibrated probabilities.
